theorems.name: Submission.allard52_density_constants
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (κ ω : ℝ), 0 < κ → 0 < ω → ∃ δP CP : ℝ, 0 < δP ∧ δP ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ δP ≤ κ ∧ 0 < CP ∧ CP * δP ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ δP → Real.exp (2 * (t / κ)) * ((1 + t) / (1 - 3 * t) ^ n * ω) + 2 * Real.exp (t / κ) * (t / κ) ≤ (1 + CP * t) * ω ∧ (1 - CP * t) * ω ≤ Real.exp (-(t / κ)) * (ω - t / κ) ∧ Real.exp (t / κ) * (Real.exp (t / κ) * ((1 + t) / (1 - 3 * t) ^ n * ω) + t / κ - ω) ≤ CP * ω * t
